_about: Registry of bugs this codebase has produced MORE THAN ONCE. Each entry becomes an automatic check (scripts/check-known-bugs.mjs) that runs on every push and every PR and turns the run red with the bug id and the exact file:line. Owner's rule, 2026-09-11: a bug seen twice gets a checker; a red checker is fixed before anything else. Add an entry the second time you meet a bug, with both sightings, so the checker carries its own justification. Every regex entry carries a `fixture` line it must catch and a `fixtureOk` line it must leave alone; `node scripts/check-known-bugs.mjs --self-test` proves both (owner rule R28, 2026-09-13).

bugs.title: Success gated on response.statusText
bugs.why: statusText is the HTTP/1.1 reason phrase and is EMPTY under HTTP/2, so `statusText === "OK"` reads a healthy 200 as failure: the generic 'Oops! An error occurred' toast, a login that never completes, lists that never load. Production serves HTTP/2 since 2026-09-11.
seen: 2026-08 AuthContext.fetchUser and teams/[id] transfer: a valid 200 threw and logged the user out (fixed in place, comment left)
2026-09-11 VPS rehearsal: 17 more gates in 12 files (login form, modal, forgot password, verify code, LatestNews, teams, contact form, three admin screens) broke the moment nginx spoke h2
bugs.fix: check the status code: `response.status >= 200 && response.status < 300` (axios already rejects non-2xx, so usually no gate is needed at all)

bugs.title: Em dash or en dash in source or copy
bugs.why: Hard rule (owner 2026-07-13): never an em dash or en dash anywhere. They read as machine-written and the owner has asked for their removal repeatedly.
seen: 2026-08-03: 2,427 removed across roughly 300 files in both repos
2026-09-04: the design lint found six more that had crept back in
bugs.fix: a hyphen with spaces, a comma, a colon, parentheses, or reword

bugs.title: useTranslations / getTranslations namespace that does not exist in messages/en
bugs.why: next-intl renders the raw key on screen when a namespace is missing, so a whole page can ship printing 'rankings.admin.ghostTeams.title' and nothing in the build or the tests notices.
seen: 2026-08-22 /a/rankings/ghost-teams: useTranslations('rankings.admin.ghostTeams') with no such namespace in en, fr or pt; ~100 raw keys live
2026-08-30 organizer edit tabs printed 8 raw keys, live since 2026-08-22
bugs.fix: add the namespace object to messages/en/<first segment>.json (then run pnpm i18n:translate), or fix the namespace string

bugs.title: authHeaders() called inside try/catch to make auth optional
bugs.why: authHeaders() throws SessionExpiredError when there is no token, and that error dispatches auth:session-expired from its CONSTRUCTOR. A try/catch swallows the throw but the event has already opened the login modal, so a public page greets every logged-out visitor with 'Session expired'.
seen: 2026-09-12 lib/draws.ts optionalHeaders wrapped authHeaders() in try/catch; the post-deploy walk of FE #40 then showed the same modal from two OLDER sites too, lib/organizers getEventRating and lib/sponsors forEvent (both documented as optional auth, both calling authHeaders() since the 2026-08-29 throw): every guest on an event page had been greeted with Session expired for two weeks. Fixed in fix/draw-guest-session-modal: optionalAuthHeaders() in lib/http, and the modal event now fires only when a session existed this page load
bugs.fix: use optionalAuthHeaders() from lib/http for a read that is public but richer when signed in; never call authHeaders() unless the request truly needs a session

bugs.title: A date or time rendered outside the timing model (device language, device zone)
bugs.why: `new Date(x).toLocaleDateString()` passes no locale and no zone: the month name follows the DEVICE language, not the site language the reader chose, and the day follows the device zone; a bare DateField read through `new Date` is UTC midnight and shows the previous day west of UTC. Nothing about it looks wrong to whoever built the page. Owner's rule R31 (2026-09-13): everything through lib/i18n/time.ts (formatLocalTime, formatLocalDateOnly, LocalTime, LocalEventTime).
seen: 2026-08-03 the registration window showed the day before (backlog item 38)
2026-09-01 the transfer window banner hardcoded en-US
2026-09-13 29 more sites across 19 files (admin audit rows, order dates, market expiries, chart axes, lib/utils formatDate with 67 callers), all fixed the same day
bugs.fix: formatLocalTime(value, mode) / formatLocalDateOnly for a bare date / <LocalTime/> for visible text; chart axes: new Intl.DateTimeFormat(getActiveLocale(), {..., timeZone: getBrowserTimeZone()}). The dedicated checker is scripts/check-datetime.mjs (run by check-all); this entry only names the class.

bugs.title: A fetch whose answer is never read, followed by a success toast
bugs.why: `await fetch(...)` alone never throws on a 4xx or 5xx; fetch resolves with the response and only rejects on a network failure. A save written as `await fetch(...); toast.success(...)` tells the person it saved whatever the server said. Read `res.ok` and the body's message and code; a call that really is fire-and-forget says so on the line.
seen: 2026-09-18 the organizer edit page's Sponsor tab: the whole form 400s on prizepool_cash_value and the screen says 'Sponsor settings saved!' (found on the Chrome walk of the sponsor requirement fix)
2026-09-18 the same shape on the admin Sponsor tab and the organizer Waitlist tab (three sites, one pattern)
bugs.fix: const res = await fetch(...); if (!res.ok) { const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({})); throw Object.assign(new Error(body?.message || res.statusText), { response: { data: body } }); } ... or mark a deliberate one with `// fire-and-forget: <why>` on the await line
